verdict.rationale: BugSnag (via SmartBear) documents a self-hosted MCP server with OAuth 2.0 support and links to an official smartbear-mcp GitHub repo, confirming an official MCP server exists. missing for 10: first-party BugSnag docs detailing setup/usage of the MCP server itself, independent hands-on confirmation of connecting an agent successfully, and clarity on whether it's self-hosted only vs. also cloud-hosted.
